A local phone number your agent answers, in the area code you choose. Every plan includes one. It works alongside your existing line, so calls can transfer to staff, or staff can answer first. Put it on your website, Google Maps and your socials and the agent is live.
Can I keep my existing business number?

Yes. Set up call forwarding with your phone provider and calls reach your agent only when your line is busy or unanswered, or every time if you prefer. Your customers keep dialing the number they already know.
How do callers react to an AI?

Callers are told they're speaking with an AI assistant, and they get an answer right away, 24/7, instead of voicemail. Goodcall's voices and response times are built so callers don't hear a phone tree.
Can I change what my agent says?
Yes, all of it: the greeting when it answers, the goodbye when it's done, and everything between. Skills and flows shape how it handles any question or request.
What happens when my agent can't answer something?

It hands off. By default it transfers the call to your business line; you can point it at a person or a department instead, have it take a message, send a self-service link, or schedule a callback. And it tells you what it heard, so you can add the workflow.
